question: What body should be made for Īśāna by the best measure of ten tālas?
premises: One should make the body of Īśāna.
This is done by the best of ten tālas.
inference: The verse instructs making the body of Īśāna by the best measure of ten tālas.
plain_english: One should make the body of Īśāna by the best of ten tālas.
